newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish shares end choppy day up, Ericsson falls.
newsitem.headline: Swedish shares end choppy day up, Ericsson falls.

text.p: Share prices closed mixed on Tuesday, boosted by forestry companies, with market indices ending an up-and-down day on the plus side.
The market's general index gained 0.71 percent to 2,149.95 in turnover of 3.6 billion crowns.
Blue chip shares were mixed. Telecoms firm Ericsson, posting losses for most of the session, ended one crown lower at 192.50. Astra rose in early trade but edged down to close up 0.50 crown at 292.
Market focus was on Sandvik and AssiDoman, which posted nine-month results. Sandvik rose 4.50 crowns to 155.

The tools and speciality metals company posted an 18 percent fall in nine month profits at 3.54 billion crowns after financial items, and repeated an earlier forecast that 1996 results would be lower than last year's.

Forestry company AssiDoman posted a 52 percent fall in nine-month profits at 1.62 billion crowns after financial items, in line with market expectations. The share gained three crowns to 165 and the sector index soared 2.9 percent.
MoDo, due to report results on Wednesday, added six crowns to 177.50 ion its B-share. Analysts said the fact that Assidoman landed on target boded well for MoDo.
"There's uncertainty again about pulp prices but possibly Assi's results improved sentiment a bit. Forestry has not exactly cheered the market in recent months," one broker said.
